statements.statement: At an annual inspection, semiannual checks are not required.

evidence_quotes: Perform all (S) inspections in addition to (A) inspections at the time of the annual inspection.

Correct CDR function is
determined by checking vacuum with a
water manometer. (para. 3-9a).
statements.reason: Annual inspections include semiannual inspections, and the semiannual air-intake inspection checks CDR function with a water manometer.
statements.statement: Annual inspections include testing the CDR valve.

evidence_quotes:
Wiping with a rag
is the only authorized method of
cleaning.
statements.reason: The passage says wiping with a rag is the only authorized cleaning method.
statements.statement: When cleaning the air-intake CDR valve, wiping with a rag is required.

evidence_quotes: Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
statements.reason: The passage explicitly says not to clean the CDR valve with solvent.
statements.statement: When cleaning the air-intake CDR valve, using solvent is prohibited.

evidence_quotes:
Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
This will damage the diaphragm in-
side the CDR valve.
statements.reason: The solvent warning explicitly states this consequence.
statements.statement: Cleaning the air-intake CDR valve with solvent will damage its diaphragm.
